input:
CURRENT SCENE:
孟子的妈妈觉得孟子取得良好的教育是很重要的，所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好，就打算跟孟子搬家。孟子的妈妈带孟子不是搬到城市，而是搬到了孟子老师的家。

ITEMS:

[I32] 孟子的妈妈觉得孟子【取得】良好的教育是很重要的   correction: 取得 → 接受   strength: error
  checker's note: 取得 does not collocate with 教育; one receives education
  rule card (collocation_selection, Vocabulary): Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <word/expression> does not normally collocate with <noun/action/situation>; use <correct> instead.  Her terms: Time + 期间, V.得很厉害, 着durative, no了for habit/routine
  her past correction: 孟母一直觉得[受到→接受]教育很重要
  her past correction: 孟母一直想[+让]她的孩子受到良好的教育 — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈[不是轻松的妈妈，而且她是厉害的妈妈→在教育方面很厉害] — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong

[I33] 所以孟子【的】妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子的教育不太好   correction: 的 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction: 可是孟子的妈妈[有别的看法→就抱怨] — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  her past correction: 最后孟母觉得不是孟子不好[-的男孩]

[I34] 所以孟子的妈妈认为这样的地方对儿子【的教育】不太好   correction: 的教育 → (delete)   strength: suggestion
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈一直[想她的儿子在很好的地方长大→想让她的儿子在很好的地方长大] — her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.
  her past correction: 最后孟母觉得不是孟子不好[-的男孩]

[I35] 就打算【跟】孟子搬家   correction: 跟 → 让   strength: suggestion
  rule card (haide_harmful_result, Vocabulary): Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: after 害得 + <person/noun>, use a genuinely harmful result; <neutral or mild result> is not harmful enough.  Her terms: 害得 + N/sb. + Harmful result, 害得+Sb.+V., 害得 + clause (harmful result)
  her past correction: 这个想法⟦害得她跟孟子搬家⟧ — her note: 害得+harmful result, 搬家itself is not harmful
  her past correction: 孟子才三岁[+就]开始搬家 — her note: 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: 现在孟子和孟母不[-是]打算搬家 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong

[I36] 孟子的妈妈【^】带孟子不是搬到城市   correction: ∅ → 不是   strength: suggestion
  rule card (modal_and_control_verb_complements, Grammar): 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 想 needs a following action (想 + V.); use 想让 + <person> + <V.> if the person is meant to do the action.  Her terms: 想 + V., 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction: [-孟子跟他的妈妈]已经搬家了

[I37] 孟子的妈妈带孟子【不是】搬到城市   correction: 不是 → 没有   strength: error
  checker's note: completed negative action needs 没有 rather than 不是
  rule card (modal_and_control_verb_complements, Grammar): 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 想 needs a following action (想 + V.); use 想让 + <person> + <V.> if the person is meant to do the action.  Her terms: 想 + V., 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 孟子的妈妈叫[-了]孟子搬家 — her note: 叫/让 is a modal verb, no了
  her past correction: 孟子跟他的妈妈[已经→就又]搬家了
  her past correction: 所以妈妈[跟孟子一起→带孟子]搬家

items.explanation: 取得 does not normally collocate with 教育; use 接受教育 instead.
It would be more natural to say 孟子妈妈 here. The relationship is already clear, so 的 can be omitted.
It would be more natural to say 对儿子不太好. The shorter phrase is clear from the context.
It would be more natural to say 让孟子搬家 if you mean that his mother planned for Mencius to move.
It would be more natural to add 不是 to make a 不是……而是…… contrast between the two places.
For a completed negative action, use 没有, not 不是. Say 没有带孟子搬到城市.
